     j k        move (or up, down)                      |
     g G        top, bottom                             |
     PgUp PgDn  a page up, down                         |
     Enter      open; into an epic                      |
     Esc        back                                    |
     l h        unfold, fold; into, out of              |
     Tab 1 2 3  switch tab                              |
     /          filter by title or id                   |
     y          copy id and title                       |
     Y          copy with details                       |
     x          done, or reopen                         |
     s          snooze                                  |
